caption: The drawing features two metallic objects with a bronze or dark brass coloration lying on a plain, off-white background. Each object has a long, curved body ending in a stylized animal head with circular and oval shapes forming the eyes. The objects appear to have loops at one end, possibly for attachment or handling. The bodies of the objects are smoothly contoured and decorated with pronounced curves, giving them an organic, flowing shape. The objects are depicted in a way that suggests they are three-dimensional, with clear shading and highlights, and are oriented perpendicularly to each other, overlapping slightly. Faint guidelines or construction lines are visible in the background, converging towards a vanishing point, adding to the sense of perspective in the composition. There is minimal additional detail or background, focusing attention solely on the two featured objects.
title: Wrought Iron Bit
